24: /**
25:  * A class representing a JSON primitive value. A primitive value
26:  * is either a String, a Java primitive, or a Java primitive
27:  * wrapper type.
28:  *
29:  * @author Inderjeet Singh
30:  * @author Joel Leitch
31:  */
32: public final class JsonPrimitive extends JsonElement {
33: 
34:   private final Object value;
35: 
36:   /**
37:    * Create a primitive containing a boolean value.
38:    *
39:    * @param bool the value to create the primitive with.
40:    */
41:   @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") // superclass constructor
42:   public JsonPrimitive(Boolean bool) {
43:     value = Objects.requireNonNull(bool);
44:   }
45: 
46:   /**
47:    * Create a primitive containing a {@link Number}.
48:    *
49:    * @param number the value to create the primitive with.
50:    */
51:   @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") // superclass constructor
52:   public JsonPrimitive(Number number) {
53:     value = Objects.requireNonNull(number);
54:   }
55: 
56:   /**
57:    * Create a primitive containing a String value.
58:    *
59:    * @param string the value to create the primitive with.
60:    */
61:   @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") // superclass constructor
62:   public JsonPrimitive(String string) {
63:     value = Objects.requireNonNull(string);
64:   }
65: 
66:   /**
67:    * Create a primitive containing a character. The character is turned into a one character String
68:    * since JSON only supports String.
69:    *
70:    * @param c the value to create the primitive with.
71:    */
72:   @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") // superclass constructor
73:   public JsonPrimitive(Character c) {
74:     // convert characters to strings since in JSON, characters are represented as a single
75:     // character string
76:     value = Objects.requireNonNull(c).toString();
77:   }
78: 
79:   /**
80:    * Returns the same value as primitives are immutable.
81:    *
82:    * @since 2.8.2
83:    */
84:   @Override
85:   public JsonPrimitive deepCopy() {
86:     return this;
87:   }
88: 
89:   /**
90:    * Check whether this primitive contains a boolean value.
91:    *
92:    * @return true if this primitive contains a boolean value, false otherwise.
93:    */
94:   public boolean isBoolean() {
95:     return value instanceof Boolean;
96:   }
97: 
98:   /**
99:    * Convenience method to get this element as a boolean value.
100:    * If this primitive {@linkplain #isBoolean() is not a boolean}, the string value
101:    * is parsed using {@link Boolean#parseBoolean(String)}. This means {@code "true"} (ignoring
102:    * case) is considered {@code true} and any other value is considered {@code false}.
103:    */
104:   @Override
105:   public boolean getAsBoolean() {
106:     if (isBoolean()) {
107:       return (Boolean) value;
108:     }
109: 	// Check to see if the value as a String is "true" in any case.
110:     return Boolean.parseBoolean(getAsString());
111:   }
112: 
113:   /**
114:    * Check whether this primitive contains a Number.
115:    *
116:    * @return true if this primitive contains a Number, false otherwise.
117:    */
118:   public boolean isNumber() {
119:     return value instanceof Number;
120:   }
121: 
122:   /**
123:    * Convenience method to get this element as a {@link Number}.
124:    * If this primitive {@linkplain #isString() is a string}, a lazily parsed {@code Number}
125:    * is constructed which parses the string when any of its methods are called (which can
126:    * lead to a {@link NumberFormatException}).
127:    *
128:    * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if this primitive is neither a number nor a string.
129:    */
130:   @Override
131:   public Number getAsNumber() {
132:     if (value instanceof Number) {
133:       return (Number) value;
134:     } else if (value instanceof String) {
135:       return new LazilyParsedNumber((String) value);
136:     }
137:     throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Primitive is neither a number nor a string");
138:   }
139: 
140:   /**
141:    * Check whether this primitive contains a String value.
142:    *
143:    * @return true if this primitive contains a String value, false otherwise.
144:    */
145:   public boolean isString() {
146:     return value instanceof String;
147:   }
148: 
149:   // Don't add Javadoc, inherit it from super implementation; no exceptions are thrown here
150:   @Override
151:   public String getAsString() {
152:     if (value instanceof String) {
153:       return (String) value;
154:     } else if (isNumber()) {
155:       return getAsNumber().toString();
156:     } else if (isBoolean()) {
157:       return ((Boolean) value).toString();
158:     }
159:     throw new AssertionError("Unexpected value type: " + value.getClass());
160:   }
161: 
162:   /**
163:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
164:    */
165:   @Override
166:   public double getAsDouble() {
167:     return isNumber() ? getAsNumber().doubleValue() : Double.parseDouble(getAsString());
168:   }
169: 
170:   /**
171:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
172:    */
173:   @Override
174:   public BigDecimal getAsBigDecimal() {
175:     return value instanceof BigDecimal ? (BigDecimal) value : new BigDecimal(getAsString());
176:   }
177: 
178:   /**
179:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
180:    */
181:   @Override
182:   public BigInteger getAsBigInteger() {
183:     return value instanceof BigInteger ?
184:         (BigInteger) value : new BigInteger(getAsString());
185:   }
186: 
187:   /**
188:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
189:    */
190:   @Override
191:   public float getAsFloat() {
192:     return isNumber() ? getAsNumber().floatValue() : Float.parseFloat(getAsString());
193:   }
194: 
195:   /**
196:    * Convenience method to get this element as a primitive long.
197:    *
198:    * @return this element as a primitive long.
199:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
200:    */
201:   @Override
202:   public long getAsLong() {
203:     return isNumber() ? getAsNumber().longValue() : Long.parseLong(getAsString());
204:   }
205: 
206:   /**
207:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
208:    */
209:   @Override
210:   public short getAsShort() {
211:     return isNumber() ? getAsNumber().shortValue() : Short.parseShort(getAsString());
212:   }
213: 
214:  /**
215:   * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
216:   */
217:   @Override
218:   public int getAsInt() {
219:     return isNumber() ? getAsNumber().intValue() : Integer.parseInt(getAsString());
220:   }
221: 
222:   /**
223:    * @throws NumberFormatException {@inheritDoc}
224:    */
225:   @Override
226:   public byte getAsByte() {
227:     return isNumber() ? getAsNumber().byteValue() : Byte.parseByte(getAsString());
228:   }
229: 
230:   /**
231:    * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if the string value of this
232:    * primitive is empty.
233:    * @deprecated This method is misleading, as it does not get this element as a char but rather as
234:    * a string's first character.
235:    */
236:   @Deprecated
237:   @Override
238:   public char getAsCharacter() {
239:     String s = getAsString();
240:     if (s.isEmpty()) {
241:       throw new UnsupportedOperationException("String value is empty");
242:     } else {
243:       return s.charAt(0);
244:     }
245:   }
246: 
247:   /**
248:    * Returns the hash code of this object.
249:    */
250:   @Override
251:   public int hashCode() {
252:     if (value == null) {
253:       return 31;
254:     }
255:     // Using recommended hashing algorithm from Effective Java for longs and doubles
256:     if (isIntegral(this)) {
257:       long value = getAsNumber().longValue();
258:       return (int) (value ^ (value >>> 32));
259:     }
260:     if (value instanceof Number) {
261:       long value = Double.doubleToLongBits(getAsNumber().doubleValue());
262:       return (int) (value ^ (value >>> 32));
263:     }
264:     return value.hashCode();
265:   }
266: 
267:   /**
268:    * Returns whether the other object is equal to this. This method only considers
269:    * the other object to be equal if it is an instance of {@code JsonPrimitive} and
270:    * has an equal value.
271:    */
272:   @Override
273:   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
274:     if (this == obj) {
275:       return true;
276:     }
277:     if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
278:       return false;
279:     }
280:     JsonPrimitive other = (JsonPrimitive)obj;
281:     if (value == null) {
282:       return other.value == null;
283:     }
284:     if (isIntegral(this) && isIntegral(other)) {
285:       return getAsNumber().longValue() == other.getAsNumber().longValue();
286:     }
287:     if (value instanceof Number && other.value instanceof Number) {
288:       double a = getAsNumber().doubleValue();
289:       // Java standard types other than double return true for two NaN. So, need
290:       // special handling for double.
291:       double b = other.getAsNumber().doubleValue();
292:       return a == b || (Double.isNaN(a) && Double.isNaN(b));
293:     }
294:     return value.equals(other.value);
295:   }
296: 
297:   /**
298:    * Returns true if the specified number is an integral type
299:    * (Long, Integer, Short, Byte, BigInteger)
300:    */
301:   private static boolean isIntegral(JsonPrimitive primitive) {
302:     if (primitive.value instanceof Number) {
303:       Number number = (Number) primitive.value;
304:       return number instanceof BigInteger || number instanceof Long || number instanceof Integer
305:           || number instanceof Short || number instanceof Byte;
306:     }
307:     return false;
308:   }
309: }
